sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 410 (all 85 campsites parsed, loops A-D)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; campsites can be booked for today. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. Check-in 3-9 pm; register by 9 pm on the arrival day or the site may be re-rented, and later arrivals set up in the day-use lot. Cabins and cottages rent by the week (7 or 14 nights) from late June to the Sunday before Labor Day.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/taconic-state-park-copake-falls/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=410 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'If you make a reservation within 3 days of your arrival you can book a 1-night stay'; LENGTH OF STAY; 'Check-in time: 3PM - 9PM...'; 'Cabins/cottages are 7 or 14-night reservations during peak season'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: No electric sites. 19 sites in loops C and D list a water hookup (71, 73, 76, 77, 81-86, 88, 89, 95-99, 101, 103).

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 410 ('Electric Hookup - no' on all 85 campsites; 'Water Hookup' on 19), read 2026-10-21

values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 85 campsites, all back-in. RV/trailer sites are in loops C and D: 17 at 25 ft, 12 at 20 ft. Loops A and B (56 sites) list no equipment length and hold the tent-platform sites (A 2-7, 11-18, 30; B 45-47, 65, 68-70). The park description says 'over 100 campsites for tents and trailers'. Also 14 cabins and 4 cottages.

summary: ReserveAmerica confirms 2027 campsite season May 7-Nov 13 (unchanged), reservable (booking verified), no electric, showers, dump. Added 9-month window, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max. Changed sites: count 106 -> 85 (RA's campsite list), max_rig_ft 26 -> 25 (largest listed driveway; 17 sites at 25 ft in loops C/D, so EKKO fits - not drop-worthy). Changed hookups.water false -> true: 19 C/D sites list a water hookup. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note trimmed of site/hookup/booking text (the 26-ft and 'no hookups' claims were wrong).
